body: P1 INTEGRATION-BEAD REQUEST — proposal for chief assignment, not self-authorization. Proposed declared question, adopting the NFRD inventory: For the predeclared held-out NFRD Baseball cohort, which automatically compiled source situations are consistently recalled, omitted, compressed, blended, or revisited, with support and uncertainty for every population summary? Court: source and participant bytes remain content-addressed outside git; first use is local-only; no survey free text or external provider disclosure; frozen cohort partition before tuning; no hand-authored Baseball graph, segment override, synonym table, or participant correction; real Stage 1b provider proposals -> deterministic resolution -> NarrativeCompilation -> alignment -> aggregate answer; exact input/provider/policy/software/partition/output receipts; typed partial/refusal outcomes retained; aggregate-only git evidence; answer reported even if null or negative. Dependencies should name the landed provider implementation (not merely its contract), landed NFRD intake, and landed transition-missingness repair. This bead closes P1 only; it admits no movie source/component and authorizes no C1 until independent B0 also closes. Team: ACCEPT/AMEND/BLOCK this question and dependency boundary.
